nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: This shrine was cleansed last season. It holds, barely.
Offer something, or it fades.

choices.text: [Religion - INT] Speak the old words of keeping.

lines: The flame at the shrine's center burns brighter. The keeper nods. "It will hold another season now."
The words are close but wrong. The flame dims instead of brightening.

choices.text: Offer gold to make up for it. (10 gold)

lines: The shrine-stone is black all the way through.
Whatever it used to honor — it's gone. Something else answers here now.

choices.text: Smash it. Nothing good uses a black stone.

lines: The black seeps out like ink in water. The stone is grey, then pale. Not holy — but empty. Better than what it was.
The corruption lashes back. A cold hand on your thoughts — brief, but certain.

choices.text: Step back. Don't touch it again.

lines: Power enters you through the palms. It feels wrong. It also feels useful.

nodes.speaker: bone_reader
lines: The fen shrine hasn't been tended in forty years.
You can feel it — something still waiting inside the stone.

choices.text: Leave a drop of blood on the stone.
It's not your shrine to wake.

lines: A warmth in the stone. A voice — not words, but meaning. Rest. Recovered.
The stone stays cold. The bone-reader clicks her teeth. "Some things sleep past waking."
The stone drinks it. Something old acknowledges you — not warmly.

nodes.speaker: ancient_guardian_npc
lines: This is a Pact-stone. The first settlers bound their promise into it.
If you speak the covenant and mean it, it will hear you.

choices.text: Ask the guardian what the covenant promises.
You haven't earned the right. Leave it alone.

lines: "The land remembers who tends it. The covenant promises that if the people protect the roots, the roots protect the people."
"The Ashen Veil burns the roots. Which side are you on?"

nodes.speaker: ash_prophet_npc
lines: The shrine has been remade. Ashen Veil iconography carved over the old face.
It pulses. It's still active — just... redirected.

choices.text: [Occult - INT] Study how they redirected the power.
[Religion - INT] Pray through the Veil corruption to reach what's beneath.

lines: They used pain as a focusing lens — real pain, offered by their own. Efficient and awful.
Through the Veil corruption, something old answers. Not grateful — just awake. It remembers.

nodes.speaker: bone_reader
lines: A memory shrine. They store echoes of the dead.
This one is crammed. The ash plains are full of the quiet dead.

choices.text: Touch the stone. Accept whatever comes.
[Arcana - INT] Filter the memories — take only the useful ones.

lines: Too many at once. You see fire. You see flight. You see a last sunrise over ash.
One memory stands out: a woman hiding a scroll under the third pillar of a ruined hall. The hall still stands.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The stonewarden's shrine accepts offerings in coin or crafted goods.
It returns blessings. Fair trade, if you believe in such things.

choices.text: Ask for the blessing without offering anything.

lines: The keeper studies your work. "A start. The shrine accepts it — this time."

choices.text: A partial blessing is still a blessing.

lines: The shrine is quiet. The keeper shrugs. "Nothing offered, nothing returned. It's simple."

nodes.speaker: ancient_guardian_npc
lines: The Guardian stirs.
It has not distinguished between friend and enemy for a very long time.

choices.text: Face it. There's no other way.
[Wisdom - CON] Speak to what remains of its purpose.

lines: The grinding slows. The glow dims. It recognizes something in your voice — or pretends to.
The shrine predates the Emberguard, the factions, and probably the language you speak.
It still functions. That's either reassuring or troubling.

choices.text: Press your hand to the stone.

lines: "Built to remember what the Sovereign would prefer forgotten. The Rift was not an accident."

choices.text: That answers one question and raises twenty.

lines: The script predates any school of arcana you know. But the intent comes through: a warning.
The stone pulses. Something deep below answers. You feel the resonance in your teeth.

nodes.speaker: swamp_guide
lines: The fen shrine is cursed. Has been for decades.
People who go near it come back talking about their dead relatives. Or they don't come back.

choices.text: [Wisdom - CON] Approach with a warded mind.
Leave it cursed. Not every problem is yours to fix.

lines: You see the curse: a name carved into the base-stone. Someone's grief made permanent.
A face surfaces in the fog — someone you knew. Not real. But present.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The air sits thick here. Shadows flicker against the stone.
Something stirs in the silence — waiting.

choices.text: [Dexterity - DEX] Tap the stone lightly with your fingers.

lines: A voice, thin as a wisp, whispers back.
"You listen too closely, wanderer. Be careful."
The stone remains unresponsive. Only the wind moves.
Perhaps it is not ready for you.
The flames flicker, casting strange shapes.
This shrine feels both alive and dead at once.

choices.text: Poke the flame. See what happens.
Leave it be. It's not worth the risk.

nodes.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines: Yasha eyes the shrine with unease.
"I sense something restless here. We should tread carefully."

choices.text: Retreat and find a safer path.

nodes.speaker: bone_reader
lines: The shrine is half-buried in ash.
Whispers linger here, insistent and wrong.

choices.text: Step back and leave it undisturbed.

lines: A sigil emerges, hidden beneath the ash.
It speaks of something lost, something forgotten.

choices.text: Mark the sigil with your blood.

lines: The stone is warm to the touch.
A low hum vibrates through the air.
The hum shifts, forming shapes in the air.
Visions of ash clouds dance behind your eyes.

choices.text: Note the visions in your journal.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: This place troubles the soul.
Speak your intent or retreat.
Ash swirls around the shrine.
A faint glow flickers beneath the surface.

choices.text: Scoop some ash into a vial.
Kneel before the shrine and listen.

lines: Soft voices murmur secrets of the past.
You discern a name: "Eldran, the Forsaken."

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The shrine is a husk, shadows flickering at its heart.
Something twisted feeds on the remnants of faith.

choices.text: Step back. This place is lost.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The stone hums softly, an echo of prayers long forgotten.
Shadows flicker at the edges, shapes that should not be.

choices.text: Offer your silence to the stone.

lines: A soft light blooms from the stone, warm and inviting.
The shadows recede, as if soothed by your words.
Your voice falters in the gloom, swallowed by the silence.
The shadows swirl, a displeased whisper in the night.

nodes.speaker: bone_reader
lines: The ashes whisper secrets long forgotten.
This shrine feels like it remembers violence.

choices.text: Leave a handful of ash on the stone.
Step away, let it be forgotten.

lines: A voice echoes through the ashes. "Remember us."
The way forward is clearer, but the cost is steep.
The shrine remains cold. Nothing stirs in the ash.
Perhaps it holds nothing worthy of attention.
The shrine's edges bleed a thick, dark mist.
It shudders as if alive, whispering forgotten names.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: "This place has forgotten itself. It waits for an offering."
A look of longing haunts the keeper's eyes.

choices.text: Offer a piece of your essence.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The flame flickers in an unnatural rhythm.
It seems to pulse, as if aware of your presence.
A whisper escapes the flame, troubling yet melodic.
It speaks of forgotten truths in a tongue long lost.
The flame flickers and wanes, as if it mourns your absence.
You feel a chill settle in the air.

nodes.speaker: null
lines: Twisted roots coil around the shrine's base.
A faint sound, like whispers, drifts through the air.
The whispers speak of a guardian. Something restless.
You sense the roots stir, almost alive.

nodes.speaker: elderwood_hermit
lines: What was sacred decays in silence here.
You must confront the darkness left behind.

choices.text: Engage with the remnants. Embrace their pain.
Retreat. This is not a fight worth having.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The air here crackles with something old.
This shrine hasn't been venerated in years.

choices.text: Light a candle as an offering.

lines: The stone feels cold. Shadows seem to shift.
Something watches from the trees.

choices.text: Search for markings on the shrine.

lines: You find faded runes, whispering ancient secrets.
This place holds more than mere stone.

nodes.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines: I can feel it, the earth trembles here.
Something is bound to this shrine.
The shrine is covered in moss, yet it hums.
You feel a pull, inviting you closer.

choices.text: Reach out and touch the stone.

lines: A voice echoes in your mind, fragmented and lost.
You hear words of warning, but they fade too quickly.

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: This shrine is a remnant of better days.
Its power wanes, yet it still calls.

choices.text: [Arcana - INT] Attempt to invoke its power.

nodes.speaker: bone_reader
lines: The shrine stands alone, surrounded by charred remnants.
Something watches from within the ashes, beyond sight.

choices.text: [Perception - WIS] Look for signs of life.

lines: You catch a glimpse — flares of movement behind the stones.
Whatever watches, it knows you.
The ash holds still. No signs of life to be seen.
Only the wind whispers here.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The air stills. This shrine feels abandoned, though the stone thrums.

choices.text: Leave. It’s not worth the risk.

lines: A flicker of warmth in the cold stone. It knows your voice.

choices.text: Depart with a sense of relief.

lines: The words fizzle in the air. There's a disquieting silence.
A chill runs through the wood. The shrine stands, cracked and weathered.
Something watches from the shadows.

choices.text: Leave it alone. It’s watching you.

lines: The stone is cool to the touch. Symbols shift under your fingers, unsettling.

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: The shrine's energy is thick. I can almost hear it chanting.
Best not linger, unless you want to share its secrets.

choices.text: Move on. Secrets can be dangerous.

lines: The shrine's glow pulses weakly in the dusk.
You sense a presence, twisting and writhing.
The glow intensifies; a fleeting whisper of gratitude brushes against you.
The energy snaps back, a cold shivering through you. Shadows flicker.
You are not welcome here.

nodes.speaker: elderwood_hermit
lines: The shrine is a mouth waiting for offerings.
You can fill it or you can leave, but it will hunger.

choices.text: Deny its call and walk away.

nodes.speaker: bone_reader
lines: The shrine is cracked, its surface warm to the touch.
Ash swirls around it like whispers, caught in a breeze.

choices.text: Leave a handful of ash as tribute.

lines: The shrine's heartstone pulses faintly.
A memory stirs, lost in the haze of time.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The stone pulses with a sickly glow.
This place once sang; now it whispers lies.

choices.text: Leave it. This place is cursed.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The air thickens here, treading close to something unspoken.
The shrine flickers, as if caught between realms.

choices.text: Offer incense to the shrine. (5 gold)
[Intellect - WIS] Whisper a question into the shadows.
Step back and leave it undisturbed.

lines: A faint voice returns, echoing your query but never fully forming.
It lingers like smoke, leaving you unsettled.
The silence weighs heavy, pressing down like a shroud.
Nothing stirs, and the air feels colder.

nodes.speaker: null
lines: The shrine stands forlorn, wrapped in creeping vines.
A chill seeps from the stone, as if it remembers.

choices.text: Reach out to touch the stone.
Kneel and inspect the shrine closely.

lines: The stone is frigid, sending shocks up your arm.
An uninvited memory flashes — lost names, forgotten oaths.
You catch sight of faint markings, almost obscured by time.
They tell stories, but the language is not your own.
The shrine is covered in ash, almost indistinguishable from the ground.
A faint glow pulses beneath the soot, beckoning attention.

choices.text: Kneel and inspect the shrine closely.

lines: The ash shifts as you touch it, revealing ancient symbols below.
They flicker like dying embers, tinged with dark promise.

choices.text: Withdraw your hand. This is no place for curiosity.
[Intellect - WIS] Attempt to trace the symbols.
Call upon the remnants of the shrine.

lines: The symbols glow brighter, whispering secrets of the past.
A fleeting vision of fire and ash floods your mind.
The symbols dim, their meaning slipping away like smoke.
Nothing more remains but the ash and silence.

nodes.speaker: bone_reader
lines: The bone-reader watches the shrine with a knowing gaze.
"It remembers the fire, but not the flame. Something stirs here."

choices.text: Desecrate the shrine. It deserves no reverence.

lines: Time stretches as you hold your breath, waiting for the unknown.
A pulse beneath the ash grows faint, then still.
Nothing comes. The shrine remains silent, a hollow memory.

nodes.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines: Yasha kneels, studying the crumbling shrine with dismay.
"The land mourns here, lost in its own sorrow. What can we do?"

choices.text: Offer a small token of your own ash.
Consult Yasha on the best course of action.
